details.title: Tonguing
details.lead: Short, even notes on a steady stream of air. The letters under the notes are the syllables: T is the tip of the tongue, K the back of it. Start slowly and keep T and K sounding the same.
facts: Single tongue on B♭4, Single tongue, up and down the B♭ scale, Double tongue on B♭4, Double tongue, up and down the B♭ scale, Triple tongue on B♭4, Triple tongue, up and down the B♭ scale
